projects.name: Banjo: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires a North American 1.0 copy of Banjo-Kazooie.

projects.name: Lighthouse (Banjo-Kazooie)
projects.romRequirements: Requires a supported Banjo-Kazooie ROM in big-endian .z64 format: USA 1.0, USA 1.1, PAL or Japan. The project does not include game data; it extracts what it needs from your copy on first start.

projects.name: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires a legally obtained US version of Conker's Bad Fur Day. The project does not include game data; you supply your own ROM.

projects.name: DKR-R (Diddy Kong Racing Recompiled)
projects.romRequirements: Requires a legally obtained US v1.0 or US Rev A/v1.1 Diddy Kong Racing ROM. Linux AppImage builds require a compatible Vulkan driver and glibc 2.38 or newer.

projects.name: Pokémon Snap: Recomp
projects.romRequirements: Requires the US Pokémon Snap ROM (SHA-1 edc7c49cc568c045fe48be0d18011c30f393cbaf); other regional ROMs are not supported. The Linux port is explicitly experimental and requires SDL2 2.26+, GTK 3, and a Vulkan 1.2 driver. The project does not include game data.

projects.name: Super Mario 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Super Mario 64 ROM (big-endian .z64, SHA-1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce). The project does not include game data. The desktop build is playable but experimental; almost all code was AI-written. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3 and FreeType.

projects.name: Perfect Dark: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA second revision of Perfect Dark (Perfect Dark (U) (V1.1)), a big-endian 32 MiB .z64 ROM with MD5 e03b088b6ac9e0080440efed07c1e40f. The project does not include game data. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3 and FreeType.

projects.name: Star Fox 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the North American Star Fox 64 version 1.1 (Rev A) ROM. The project does not include game assets; the game prompts you to select your own supported ROM.

projects.name: Starship (Star Fox 64)
projects.romRequirements: Requires a USA Star Fox 64 ROM, version 1.0 or 1.1. Japanese and European copies can be added later for their voices. The project does not include game data; it asks for your copy with its own file picker on first start.

projects.name: Donkey Kong 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the US Nintendo 64 version of Donkey Kong 64. Other games and arbitrary ROMs are not supported. The project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Mario Kart 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the North American Nintendo 64 version of Mario Kart 64. The project does not include game assets; you supply your own supported ROM.

projects.name: SpaghettiKart (Mario Kart 64)
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Mario Kart 64 ROM in big-endian .z64 format (SHA-1 579c48e211ae952530ffc8738709f078d5dd215e). The project does not include game data; it asks for your copy with its own file picker on first start.

projects.name: Mario Party: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Mario Party ROM as a big-endian .z64, 32 MiB, SHA-1 1159bd56730094bfc71be30113e1cfc8bacf34f3. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3, and FreeType.

projects.name: Mario Party 2: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Mario Party 2 ROM as a big-endian .z64, 32 MiB, SHA-1 166eda1c05670d337e2c3f15a5db528ae1e5d6e3. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3, and FreeType.

projects.name: Mario Party 3: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Mario Party 3 ROM as a big-endian .z64, 32 MiB, SHA-1 6beb80ff822b96bcf85dcdb512e8b2b7969d8259. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3, and FreeType.

projects.name: Super Smash Bros.: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Super Smash Bros. ROM as a big-endian .z64, 16 MiB, SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf. Linux x86-64 requires glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3, and FreeType.

projects.name: Ghostship (Super Mario 64)
projects.romRequirements: Requires a supported USA or Japan Super Mario 64 ROM in big-endian .z64 format. USA SHA-1: 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce; Japan SHA-1: 8a20a5c83d6ceb0f0506cfc9fa20d8f438cafe51. The Linux release is an AppImage distributed inside a ZIP archive.

projects.name: Banjo-Tooie: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Banjo-Tooie ROM (SHA-1 AF1A89E12B638B8D82CC4C085C8E01D4CBA03FB3). The ROM is selected in the launcher on first run. The Linux x86-64 archive includes the executable, assets, and run.sh launcher script.

projects.name: PaperBoat (Paper Mario)
projects.romRequirements: Requires the supported USA Paper Mario 64 ROM in big-endian .z64 format (SHA-1 3837f44cda784b466c9a2d99df70d77c322b97a0). The Linux release distributes paperboat.appimage inside a ZIP archive.

projects.name: DinoTale (Yoshi's Story)
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Yoshi's Story ROM (SHA-1 B13072FEF6C6DF48C07D8822C01E5BC59036F6DA). The project does not include game files; later levels and boss fights are still being tested.

projects.name: Mega Man 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own supported Mega Man 64 ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: F-Zero X: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA first-release F-Zero X ROM (big-endian .z64, 16 MiB, SHA-1 5f658e88ffa9de23cba6986a8fd3d3a90d7b4340). Other regions, revisions and the 64DD Expansion Kit are not supported.

projects.name: Mario Golf: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the USA Mario Golf ROM as a big-endian .z64 (32 MiB, SHA-1 e2c4e7a905b29529b49a1619a401fe699224829b), or the supported 24 MiB dump. Other regions and revisions are not supported.

projects.name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (Zelda 64: Recompiled)
gameTitles: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
projects.romRequirements: Requires the North American Majora's Mask ROM. The project does not include game assets. Note: this release is for Majora's Mask; Ocarina of Time support is still in development.
projects.romFile: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (USA) ROM

projects.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian (Majora's Mask)
gameTitles: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
projects.romRequirements: Requires a supported Majora's Mask ROM: USA 1.0 or the USA GameCube version. The project does not include game data; it extracts what it needs from your copy on first start.
projects.romFile: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (USA) ROM

projects.name: Ship of Harkinian (Ocarina of Time)
gameTitles: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
projects.romRequirements: Requires a legally acquired supported Ocarina of Time ROM. The Linux AppImage does not include the original game's copyrighted assets.
projects.romFile: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time ROM

projects.name: Open Nectar (Pikmin & Pikmin 2)
projects.romRequirements: Supports legally obtained Pikmin and Pikmin 2 GameCube discs. The project does not include game data; install each game from your own disc image through the Open Nectar launcher. Linux AppImage requires x86-64 and glibc 2.29 or newer.

projects.name: Super Mario Strikers (Strikers)
projects.romRequirements: Requires game data from your own supported Super Mario Strikers disc image. Linux AppImages are available for x86-64 and ARM64; the release also provides Linux tar.gz archives.

projects.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess (Dusklight)
gameTitles: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Twilight Princess disc image. Dusklight accepts commercial GameCube and Wii discs except the Korean Wii release, but is based on the GameCube decompilation and presents the GameCube version's HUD and related behavior. Linux AppImages are published for x86-64 and ARM64.
projects.romFile: Twilight Princess disc image (GameCube or Wii)

projects.name: Luigi's Mansion Recompiled

launch.firstStartNote: The first start builds the game from your disc, which takes a few minutes.

projects.romRequirements: Requires your own USA (GLME01) and/or European (GLMP01) Luigi's Mansion disc image. No game data is included.
projects.romFile: Luigi's Mansion (USA or Europe) disc image

projects.name: MediEvil Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own USA MediEvil disc image: the .cue file with its .bin tracks. The launcher checks for the .NET 10 runtime and installs it in your home folder if it is missing.

projects.name: Bloody Roar II Recompiled
gameTitles: Bloody Roar II: The New Breed
Bloody Roar 2: Bringer of the New Age
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Bloody Roar II disc image (.bin/.cue, .iso or .chd), USA (SCUS-94424) or Europe (SLES-01722); Japan is experimental. The launcher asks for it on first run.
projects.romFile: Bloody Roar II (USA or Europe) disc image

projects.name: Shadow Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires files from your own original Xbox copy of Shadow the Hedgehog. GameCube and PlayStation 2 versions do not work.

projects.name: Ninja Gaiden Black Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Ninja Gaiden Black disc image (.iso, a full Redump dump, or the .7z/.zip it came in) or a folder of extracted files with default.xbe. It is installed once on first start (about 6 GB).

projects.name: Lost Odyssey Recomp
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Lost Odyssey discs: one four-disc set (Asian multilingual or USA/Europe), as ISOs, extracted folders or GOD data. Disc 1 is needed to start. Experimental: not every scene has been tested.

projects.name: The Simpsons Game Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Xbox 360 ISO of The Simpsons Game (USA is the main target; Europe works with less testing) and about 5 GB of space. Needs a CPU with AVX2.

projects.name: Super Metroid Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified Super Metroid (Japan, USA) ROM (.sfc or .smc, 3,145,728 bytes). RecompStation selects it in the launcher for you.

launch.firstStartNote: Its launcher opens with your ROM already selected, so you can change settings and mods before pressing Play.

projects.name: Mega Man X Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Mega Man X (USA) (Rev 1) ROM (.sfc or .smc, with or without a copier header). RecompStation selects it in the launcher for you. Optional mods use your own Mega Man X2 or X3 USA ROMs.

launch.firstStartNote: Its launcher opens with your ROM already selected, so you can change settings and mods before pressing Play.

projects.name: Bomberman 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own US Bomberman 64 ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Bomberman Hero: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own US Bomberman Hero ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Harvest Moon 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own North American Harvest Moon 64 ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Snowboard Kids 2: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own US Snowboard Kids 2 ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Space Station Silicon Valley: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own US 1.0 Space Station Silicon Valley ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Quest 64: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own US Quest 64 ROM; the project does not include game assets.

projects.name: Snowboard Kids: Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified US Snowboard Kids ROM. Choose it in the launcher on first start. The Linux build targets Ubuntu 24.04-era system libraries (SDL2, GTK 3, Vulkan).

projects.name: Glover-R
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified USA Glover ROM (revision 0, game code NGVE, 8 MiB). Choose it in the launcher on first start.

projects.name: Duke Nukem: Zero Hour Recompiled
projects.romRequirements: Requires the North American Duke Nukem: Zero Hour ROM. The project does not include game assets and accepts only that version; other ROM formats of it are converted automatically. A very early version.

projects.name: Dr. Mario 64 Recomp Plus
projects.romRequirements: Requires a clean, unmodified North American Dr. Mario 64 ROM. The project does not include game assets. Its launcher keeps its settings in the same folder as Mario Kart 64: Recompiled's (MarioKart64Recompiled).

projects.name: Super Mario World Recomp
gameTitles: Super Mario World: Super Mario Bros. 4
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified Super Mario World (USA) ROM (.sfc or .smc). RecompStation selects it in the launcher for you. An in-development preview.

launch.firstStartNote: Its launcher opens with your ROM already selected, so you can change settings and mods before pressing Play.

projects.name: DKC1Recomp
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified, headerless Donkey Kong Country (USA) v1.0 ROM. No game data is included. Windows only: on Linux it runs through Wine. Pick the ROM in its own launcher the first time. An early version.

projects.name: DKC2Recomp
gameTitles: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified Donkey Kong Country 2 (USA) v1.0 ROM. No game data is included. Windows only: on Linux it runs through Wine. Pick the ROM in its own launcher the first time. An early version.

projects.name: DKC3Recomp
gameTitles: Donkey Kong Country 3: Dixie Kong's Double Trouble!
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own unmodified Donkey Kong Country 3 (USA) ROM. No game data is included. Windows only: on Linux it runs through Wine. Pick the ROM in its own launcher the first time. An early version.

projects.name: Paper Cut
gameTitles: Paper Mario: The Thousand Year Door
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door disc image (USA, Japan or Europe). No game data is included. Add the disc in Paper Cut's own launcher the first time.
projects.romFile: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door disc image

projects.name: melee-pc
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own Super Smash Bros. Melee disc image (USA, version 1.02). No game data is included. Choose the disc in melee-pc the first time.
projects.romFile: Super Smash Bros. Melee (USA 1.02) disc image

projects.name: BlueWake
gameTitles: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
projects.romRequirements: Requires your own The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker disc image (USA GameCube release, .iso or .gcm; convert an .rvz first). No game data is included. Choose the disc when BlueWake first starts. Based on Wind Waker Recomp.
